summary: Explore a dream world filled with dungeons, nature and nightmares
description:
This is a game by two people - P
Please leave us a review 😊 thank you! ✨ 

Explore and fight your way through nature, urban and abstract themed areas in the human Young's subconscious, evoked by a 16-bit-era visual style and a moody, dream-like soundtrack. Talk to bizarre characters and survive through Game Boy-styled dungeons.

* Anodyne is a full-length, 6 hour+ adventure with NO IAPs! Buy once - play forever.
* Explore the subconscious of Young , and adventure through over 20 diverse areas.
* Features an original, 60+ minute soundtrack, to accompany the world of Anodyne.
* Extensive use of a household item.

Created by Melos Han-Tani and Marina Kittaka. Please leave a review and play the sequel Anodyne 2 as well on PC and console!

Press Quotes:

PC GAMER: "This is a game crammed with secrets, from odd encounters with equally odd characters to collectible cards..."

POLYGON: "A brilliantly designed adventure that translates well-worn mechanics into a package that feels genuinely new and exciting."

GAMESPOT: "...if you take the time to explore all of Anodyne's nooks and crannies, you'll find hours and hours of gameplay in store... beautiful visuals you encounter as you trudge through everything from unsettling suburban neighborhoods to crumbling temples, and the poignant musical score surges with emotional power."
